# Variable `TC_CXX_RUNTIME`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the C/C++ STL and runtime variant to use during the build process. Default value is ‘gnu’

You can select “gnu”, “llvm”, or “android”.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-TC_CXX_RUNTIME)
